To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

cogeneration systems for simultaneous heat, cold and electrical power production have a large potential of energy saving, especially in the case when the cogeneration system is designed for the minimum primary energy rate.

the energetic efficiency of cogeneration system for combined heat, power and cold production depends on the energy parameters of designed system, and the primary energy saving by cogeneration system for simultaneous heat, cold and electricity generation can be up to 40%.
the energetic efficiency of combined heat, cold, and power production is significantly higher than the conventional separate production of these energy flows.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a method of evaluation of energetic efficiency of cogeneration system for combined heat, power and cooling production.
the development of a method for the energetic efficiency evaluation of combined cogeneration system for heat, cold and electricity production.
the energetic efficiency of cogeneration plants for the combined heat, cold, and power production.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cogeneration system for combined heat, power and cooling is an effective method for the utilization of energy sources and the reduction of primary energy consumption.
cogeneration systems for simultaneous production of heat, power and cold have a great potential for energy saving.
the cogeneration system with the heat pump and the heat exchanger for heat recovery is the most energy efficient system for the combined heat, cold, and power production.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cogeneration systems for simultaneous production of heat, power and cold are more efficient than the conventional systems for separate production of heat power and cold.

the cogeneration systems for simultaneous heat, cold and electrical power production have large potential for energy savings and that the efficiency of these systems is higher than the efficiency of separate production of useful energy flows.
cogeneration systems for heat, cold and electricity production are very promising and can be a good alternative to the separate production of the useful energy flows.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cogeneration of heat, cold, and power is a promising technology for improving the energetic efficiency of energy conversion processes.

cogeneration systems for simultaneous production of heat, power and cold can be designed in such a way that their primary energy consumption is lower than the primary energy consumption of separate production of the same amount of useful energy.

the energetic efficiency of cogeneration system is a function of the energy parameters of cogeneration systems and that the energetic efficiency can be improved by increasing the energy efficiency of cogeneration processes.
